Search Menu
Support at Home
When it comes to finding the right provider for your home care services, it's
good to know your options. On this page, you'll find information about the
services offered under the Support at Home program through ADL Local
Guardians (Activities Daily Living).
Find a provider Search Local Guardians Pty Ltd
Print Share
Services and costs
ADL Local Guardians (Activities Daily Living)Give Feedback
=====PAGE 2=====
Estimate your Support at Home fees
The amount you and the government will each contribute to your Support at
Home fees is determined by your income and assets.
Tell us about your situation and we'll help you calculate how much you might
pay for Support at Home services from this provider.
Services that may be suitable for you
The following services may suit your needs based on your search or the
information you've provided. A full list of services is available further down this
page.
Services that may be suitable for you
Allied health assistance Nutrition supports Meal delivery
Meal preparation Home support care management

Nursing assistant clinical care Nursing care consumables
Registered nurse clinical care Direct transport
Indirect transport Flexible respite

Managing body functions Domestic life products
Continence management (non-clinical)

The Department of Health, Disability and Ageing acknowledges the Traditional
Owners and Custodians of Country throughout Australia, and their continuing
connection to land, sea and community. We pay our respects to them and their
cultures, and to Elders both past and present.
ADL Local Guardians (Activities Daily Living) is responsible for entering and maintaining the
information on this page, ensuring it is accurate, complete, and up to date. The Department of
Health, Disability and Ageing also performs checks to ensure the quality and accuracy of the data.
